description: This file defines the 'Measurement' interface which models a measurement of a value over multiple time intervals, including its properties and JSON serialization logic.

classes.name: Measurement
classes.description: Represents a measurement of a value for multiple time intervals, with methods for retrieving measurement data and serialization.

classes.name: Measurement.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains JSON field definitions relevant to the Measurement, notably 'lastMessageAt'.

methods.name: getMetricType
methods.description: Returns the type of the measurement, such as 'consumed' or 'mapped'.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Indicates whether the measurement represents a successful operation or a failure.

methods.name: getCounts
methods.description: Provides a map of duration intervals to their respective counter values.

methods.name: getLastMessageAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last message, if available.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the measurement to a JSON object, including only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the measurement to JSON with specified schema version and field selector.
